direct_field_gate.correction_to_raw_probe: estimated_delivery_price is not an IV field. The raw name matcher found the substring 'iv' only inside the word 'delivery'; that match is rejected here.

derived_reconstructibility.instrument_name_rule: BTC-<expiry>-<strike>-<C|P> supplies strike and option type at the recorded snapshot.
derived_reconstructibility.iv_delta_rule: Observed bid/ask/mark option prices, underlying price, strike, expiry and snapshot time are sufficient to solve a contemporaneous European implied volatility and delta under an explicitly frozen pricing convention.
derived_reconstructibility.limitation: The file has snapshot_time but no local capture timestamp and covers only BTC in 2024. It therefore cannot establish pre-2024 training coverage or become an official 2024 performance input.

scientific_decision.primary_pre_2024_source: Tardis Deribit month-start options_chain prefixes with exchange and local timestamps plus directly recorded bid/ask/mark IV and delta.
scientific_decision.next_gate: Run the single preregistered 2020-2023 sparse first-passage model. Development PnL remains code-closed unless the untouched 2022H2 model beats the structural-distance heuristic on both AUC and Brier score.
